links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers to same questions across a one-week interval (Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: Claude 4.5 Sonnet κ=0.872 (very good); Grok-4 κ=0.575 and ChatGPT-5 κ=0.559 (moderate) over one week.
links.quote: Regarding temporal reliability, Claude 4.5 Sonnet demonstrated “very good” consistency over one week (κ = 0.872), whereas Grok-4 (κ = 0.575) and ChatGPT-5 (κ = 0.559) showed only “moderate” reliability.

links.outcome: Accuracy difference between Turkish and English prompts for ChatGPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro
links.effect: No significant performance gap between Turkish and English outputs (p = 1.000); agreement κ ≈ 0.73.
links.quote: No significant performance gap was found between Turkish and English outputs for ChatGPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro (p = 1.000), indicating good linguistic agreement (κ ≈ 0.73).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and temporal/linguistic consistency of several LLMs on multiple-choice radiology exam questions compared to radiology residents.
